latest_release.name: v0.190.0
latest_release.body:
## 0.190.0 (2026-06-23)

### 🚀 Features

- Pi extension and docs guide ([#4938](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4938))
- **api,runner,sdk,cli:** add pause action ([#4714](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4714))
- **api,sdk:** sandbox domain allow list ([#5117](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5117))
- **dashboard:** otel config notice & alignment tweaks ([#5107](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5107))
- **dashboard:** regions & runners react query & design touchup ([#5106](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5106))
- **docs:** update computer use access / screenshot format ([#5094](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5094))
- **docs:** add datadog OTel instructions and dashboard example ([#5105](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5105))
- **guides:** Gemini CLI ([#5077](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5077))

### 🩹 Fixes

- **api:** evict notification sockets when org membership ends ([#5104](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5104))
- **api,cli:** snapshot create with sandbox class ([#5087](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5087))
- **docs:** remove oss and on-prem / rename cmc to byoc ([#5022](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5022))
- **proxy:** bound preview auth cookie acceptance to its 1h lifetime ([#5045](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5045))

### Chores

- sync go.sum for v0.189.0 ([#5101](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5101))
- Pi extension publish ([#5103](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5103))
- **sdk-go:** bump to v0.190.0 ([#5120](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5120))

### ❤️ Thank You
